name: Guessor
shortDescription: A fun word guessing game with multiple categories and timed rounds.

details.description: A word guessing game featuring categories like fruits, animals, and countries. Players must guess the correct letters within one minute per round. Correct guesses increase the score, while failure results in losing the round.
highlights: Implemented bilingual support (English/Arabic)
Built a dynamic on-screen keyboard with state management
Developed countdown timer logic for timed gameplay
Created score tracking across multiple rounds
Managed game state transitions for win/loss scenarios

name: Evenvite
shortDescription: A platform for creating and managing public and private events.

details.description: A platform for creating and managing events with invitation features. Users can choose whether an event is private or public. For private events, invitations can be sent to selected guests, while public events allow users to reserve their spot. Each invitation includes a digital card where guests can confirm their attendance and leave a short message for the event organizer.
highlights: Built RESTful APIs for event and invitation management
Designed MongoDB data models
Implemented private and public event access control
Developed guest attendance confirmation workflow
Created dynamic digital invitation card functionality

name: SkillSync
shortDescription: An online learning platform with course management and progress tracking.

details.description: An online learning platform where instructors can create and manage courses, and students can enroll, learn, and track their progress. Includes dashboards, lesson pages, and real-time progress tracking.
highlights: Integrated frontend and backend services
Developed instructor dashboard features
Restricted lesson access to enrolled students
Integrated Markdown for lesson content display
Implemented student progress tracking functionality

name: Roompickr
shortDescription: A flexible platform for booking rooms and shared spaces.

details.description: A platform for booking spaces such as meeting rooms, workspaces, study halls, and event venues. Designed to provide a safe, flexible, and inclusive booking experience.
highlights: Implemented room and venue booking functionality
Developed availability and reservation management system
Generated PDF invoices for bookings
Built user authentication and profile management

name: Equalsy
shortDescription: A simple calculator with session-based history tracking.

details.description: A simple and user-friendly calculator that performs basic and advanced calculations while keeping a temporary history of all operations during the current session. Users can see their recent calculations in a clear format, and the history resets automatically when the session ends. Features include addition, subtraction, multiplication, division.
highlights: Implemented basic arithmetic operations
Integrated Math.js for expression evaluation
Built session-based calculation history tracking
